title: Sherpa-UI flow
description: A UX flow (plan 964 N4): one act's input asked step by step, then a confirm. It is keyed by its act and said in its act's words; a page's dialog shows every step that holds, the chat one at a time, and both run the act through its one door. It asks only the act's input: the keys it runs on are the caller's. flowFaults() reads it.

act.description: The act it asks for, by id: `<type>.<verb>`.

steps.description: Its steps, in order: each a field of the act's input, said in that field's words. Every field the act needs is asked.

field.description: A field of the act's input.

when.description: Asked only when this holds over the answers of the steps before it: { "scope": { "eq": "Customer" } }.

confirm.description: It asks the reader before it runs, its words naming each answer. None: when its act changes data.
